name: 2-2:Deep Within
short:
A bizarre
monument,
has been found
within the
caverns…
long:
Client: Principal
Quest:
 Please get some data
 readings on the strange
 monument discovered
 in the caverns.
※ Job can be joined
 while in progress.

Thank you for coming,
<name job> <name hero>.

Now, to get right to
the point:

The other day, a team of
hunters reported finding
a pillar in the caves.

It's just like the pillar
found on the surface!

Our official word is that
it's a monument built by
Pioneer 1, but...

We know from the Lab's
analysis that it's
actually very ancient.

We don't know much else,
but the one down in the
caves must be related.

The hunters reported that
when they got close to
it, they were attacked.

They had to run for their
lives before they got a
chance to investigate.

Find this pillar that
they saw, and bring back
some data for us.

My secretary, Irene, has
the details. Please speak
to her.
I'm counting on you.

Please speak to Irene,
my secretary.

Strange pillars, both on
and within Ragol...

What in the world could
they possibly mean?

You haven't brought back
any data from the pillar,
err... new monument, yet?

Please, go and get some
data readings for us.

You're back safe and
sound, <hero name>.
Good job.

We will send this data
over to the Lab
immediately.

Perhaps they can learn
something about these
two pillars.

Please, go and relax
until we have further
orders for you.

Where do you think you're
going?

You haven't spoken with
Irene for the details,
yet!
Good to see you again.

We actually don't have a
precise location of the
pillar.

So, please use the
teleporter that the other
team used.

Then search the caverns
to see if you can find it
again.

Let me attach this data-
collecting device to your
gear, <name hero>.

This little device will
take complex data
readings.

Just touch the monument,
and it'll activate and do
its thing automatically.

Now, apparently, the area
in question is guarded by
many hostile creatures.

I don't think I need to
remind you to be
careful.
That is all.
Please, come back safely.

The data collector will
activate when you touch
the monument.

Watch out for any hostile
creatures and come back
with the data.

The Principal is waiting.
Please give him your
report.
Welcome back.

I'm glad to see that
you're safe.

The pillar down in those
caves --

Just what does it all
mean?

Did Rico know about these
pillars as well, I
wonder?

We'll call on you again
when needed.

Go and rest up a bit, for
now.

You've already finished
this quest.

Please select "Cancel" at
the Counter to return to
the Lobby.

Another one of those
strange monuments, this
time, underground.

I guess it's too far out
to say that THIS one was
built by Pioneer 1, too.

But, if we didn't build
those monuments...

Does that mean that there
was a preexisting
civilization on Ragol?

It looks like there's
only one of those pillars
on the surface, though…

It looks like the new
data you've brought back
should help us.

Maybe some of my
hypotheses can be made
conclusive.

Hmm? Oh, never mind
those, for now…

Do you know why there are
so many Newman orphans?

It's because a Newman
is generally the creation
of human science.

The process still isn't
perfected, so a lot of
them don't live long.

If the pillar on the
surface was built as a
monument by Pioneer 1...

Why is there another one
built underground?

The crew of Pioneer 1
had to have been hiding
something…

The situation just gets
worse every day. What's
the point to this?

Forget the investigation.
We should just leave this
planet!
You got <color 4>Monument Data<color 0>!

●The monument found
inside Ragol seems to be
extremely ancient.

We had thought that Ragol
had been devoid of any
sentient life.

But look at that pillar!
It's just like the one in
the forest!

We couldn't have built
it. Another civilization
must have existed here!

But there are no traces
of anything built outside
the forest...

If there was a
civilization here,
that's kind of strange.

I wonder if we can
decipher these markings
with these crude tools...
Saving Monument Data…
